summary: Enhance your project management skills with our PMO Implementation Course. Learn best practices, tools, and strategies to effectively manage projects.
lede: Project management office (PMO) training helps project and portfolio professionals, executives, and PMO leaders plan or strengthen a PMO. It covers assessing organizational readiness, defining the PMO’s purpose, roles, and governance, and building leadership and stakeholder support. Learners also explore resource and capacity planning, project tracking systems, change management, and ways to measure and report PMO impact.
